summary: Verified plan v4 of case-onboarding (design-only, 5 milestones, 22 steps, 2 blocked, 46 declared checker tests) on all three lenses and rejected it on one blocker. Executability 22/22, grounding 21/22, testability 21/22. All thirteen v3 blockers are genuinely closed and every one was reproduced in a fixture built independently from the cited skills' metadata examples: 45 of 46 declared checker commands exit 0 on correct artefacts, 14 matched negatives all exit non-zero, and every cross-step check passes. The one blocker is new and was not in the v3 list: M2-S05 declares settings/Sharing.settings-meta.xml as the artefact carrying the Case org-wide default, its own cited skill states that sharingModel lives on the CustomObject file and not in a settings file, and check_sharing_model.py reads object OWDs only from *.object-meta.xml — so the step test and the M2 milestone test both resolve zero OWDs and exit 0 whatever the default is, and 'sharingModel' appears nowhere in plan.json. D5, the M2 goal 'a Tier 1 agent cannot open a Billing case' and the fit-gap row 'Finance queries worked only by Finance' all rest on Private. Six warnings, three of them about claims the plan makes on its own behalf: check_validation_rules.py does not have the exit policy the S1 sweep note attributes to it, M3-S03's build-scope command becomes a false failure once M3-S04 is built, and the three M5 milestone ticks moved there by B04 and B06 name a proof sandbox the blocked M5-S02 will not produce. validate exits 0 with the same three non-standard-argument-form warnings before and after this run's write.
confidence_rationale: All three lenses ran on all 22 steps and every verdict names a file read or a command run; no refutation rests on a missing file. MEDIUM rather than HIGH because the grounding lens's gotchas and Questions-to-Ask checks were targeted rather than exhaustive across all 36 cited skills, and because every checker verdict rests on this agent's reconstruction of correct artefacts, so a checker that passed here could still fail on what metadata-builder writes. Not LOW: build_plan.py and the schema were available, mechanics validate at exit 0, and the single blocker rests on a quoted line of the cited skill plus a reproduced command output with a matched negative.

findings.title: M3-S01 and M3 milestone state an exit policy check_validation_rules.py does not have
findings.detail: Testability lens. Both descriptions say the checker 'returns 1 on ANY finding including REVIEW'; emit_result at :102-119 returns 1 only on CRITICAL/HIGH or under --strict, and neither command declares --strict. The ISBLANK blank-guard constraint is therefore carried by M3-S01's manual test, not by either exit code.

evidence.detail: unguarded ISPICKVAL(...,'') fixture -> 2 REVIEW findings, 'blocking': 0, exit 0. Same fixture under --strict -> exit 1.

findings.title: M3-S03's build-scope checker becomes a false failure once M3-S04 is built
findings.detail: Testability lens. find_xml_files reads only <manifest-dir>/assignmentRules and does not recurse, while the guard that would skip the section uses rglob and does. Green on the first pass because M3-S04 depends on M3-S03; red on any re-test after M3-S04 lands.
